portabilityLimits: Archival source is not installed in runtime and is not an automatically runnable fresh-clone test suite.
Original manifests and receipts bind original paths and omitted local files; copying a receipt does not make a partial archive a complete sealed tree.

Fixture/native-oracle code expects archived pilot rows, fifty-control JSON and exact staged Playwright 1.64.0 coreBundle.js/package.json. These inputs and dependencies are not supplied by the research mirror.

Benchmark and diagnostic plans bind absolute workspace paths, source digests, historical emitted/installed forms and environment-specific Node paths. Rebinding or adapting later changes identity and needs fresh verification.

Historical pilot readiness and author test passes are superseded for acceptance by actual postrun STOP. The 896 MiB, 90/120-second, first scheduled post-close census and similar bounds are prior diagnostic/continuation policy, not original product requirements.

Both transport candidates remain uninstalled; the incremental predecessor regression result remains 107/108. The lifecycle extension and attribution proposal remain pending, with no fresh runtime authority supplied by this archive.
